$schema: License calculation rules for LM Cloud

categories.name: IaaS
categories.description: Infrastructure as a Service - Virtual machines and compute instances

categories.name: PaaS
categories.description: Platform as a Service - Managed services, containers, serverless functions

categories.name: No-Charge
categories.description: Resources monitored at no additional cost (includes former Non-Compute types such as storage and networking)

special_counting_rules.description: Special rules for counting specific resource types

rules.note: For EKS with LM Container monitoring, count K8s pods instead of clusters
For AKS with LM Container monitoring, count K8s pods instead of clusters
For GKE with LM Container monitoring, count K8s pods instead of clusters

kubernetes_pod_counting.description: When enabled, use kubectl to count pods for container services
kubernetes_pod_counting.command: kubectl get pods --all-namespaces --no-headers -o custom-columns=Type:kind | sort | uniq -c
